name: Central India Hackathon 4.0
schedule: Registration and PPT submission close 30 Nov 2026. No time specified.
rules: Use the official CIH template and enter as a team of four.
tip: Show how your solution can scale beyond a single demonstration.

name: Imagine Cup 2027
schedule: Application deadline: 28 Feb 2027 at 11:59 pm CST.
rules: Submit a pitch deck, a 2–3 minute product demo, an Azure technical overview or architecture diagram, and written responses.
tip: Connect the customer problem to the Azure service that makes the solution possible.

name: Campus to Cloud Hackathon 2026
schedule: Registration and first-round submission close 30 Nov 2026 at 11:59 pm IST.
rules: Address a real problem in India using AWS technologies.
tip: Show one user completing a task and identify the AWS component behind it.
